learning_objectives.en: Organise and deliver a relevant response.
learning_objectives.vi: Tổ chức và triển khai câu trả lời phù hợp.

content.en: Plan a clear response, use topic vocabulary and evaluate it against transparent criteria.
content.vi: Lập dàn ý rõ, dùng từ theo chủ đề và tự đối chiếu tiêu chí.

vocabulary.example_en: The course discusses learning outcome in an education context.
vocabulary.example_vi: Khóa học đề cập đến mục tiêu đầu ra trong bối cảnh giáo dục.

vocabulary.example_en: The course discusses academic feedback in an education context.
vocabulary.example_vi: Khóa học đề cập đến phản hồi học thuật trong bối cảnh giáo dục.

vocabulary.example_en: The course discusses vocational training in an education context.
vocabulary.example_vi: Khóa học đề cập đến đào tạo nghề trong bối cảnh giáo dục.

strategies.en: Identify the question, find the relevant section, and explain why the answer fits.
strategies.vi: Xác định yêu cầu, tìm phần liên quan và giải thích lựa chọn.

common_mistakes.en: Guessing without checking what the source actually says.
common_mistakes.vi: Đoán thay vì kiểm tra thông tin gốc.

mini_review.en: Can I explain the evidence or evaluate my response?
mini_review.vi: Tôi giải thích được bằng chứng hoặc tự đánh giá bài của mình chưa?

instruction.en: Write independently before opening the model response.
instruction.vi: Tự viết trước khi mở bài mẫu.

questions.prompt_en: The bar chart shows average weekly independent-study hours reported by students in three fictional programmes in 2024 and 2025. Summarise the information and make comparisons.

answer.model_en:
The bar chart compares the average time students in three fictional programmes spent studying independently each week in 2024 and 2025.
Overall, independent-study hours increased in all three programmes. Academic students recorded the highest figures in both years, while the part-time group consistently reported the fewest hours.
In 2024, those on academic courses studied independently for an average of 12 hours a week. This was three hours more than the figure for vocational students, at nine hours, and five hours above the seven hours recorded among part-time learners. By 2025, the academic figure had reached 15 hours, representing the largest absolute increase of three hours.
The vocational programme also experienced growth, with weekly study time rising from nine to 11 hours. In contrast, part-time students showed a more modest one-hour increase, from seven to eight hours per week. Although every group spent more time studying alone in the second year, the gap between academic and part-time students widened from five to seven hours. These figures describe reported time rather than the quality of learning.

questions.explanation_en: Use the rubric to evaluate your own writing; no machine IELTS band is awarded.
